input: Start a neighborhood watch group on the street

gold.taskTitle: Start a Neighborhood Watch Group on Your Street
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to organize and launch a neighborhood watch group specifically for their street.

questions.title: What specific safety concern is motivating this?
questions.description: Understand the root reason — recent incidents, general prevention, community building, etc.

questions.title: How many households are on your street?
questions.description: Gauge the scale of the group and how many neighbors need to be reached.

questions.title: Have you already spoken to any neighbors about this?
questions.description: Determine the current level of interest or buy-in from other residents.

questions.title: Do you want to affiliate with an official program like Nextdoor or local police?
questions.description: Clarify whether this should be a formally registered watch group or an informal one.

questions.title: What is your target launch date or timeframe?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or urgency level to structure the planning timeline.

questions.title: How do you want members to communicate day to day?
questions.description: Identify the preferred communication channel — group chat, app, email list, in-person meetings, etc.

questions.title: Are you willing to be the primary leader of this group?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to lead, co-lead, or simply help get things started.
